label: Reading live state
subgoals: Choose consistent points between phases for snapshots
Expose metrics and identifiers rather than prose
Default every hook to read-only access

label: The cost of a hook
subgoals: Divide snapshot cost by the iterations between snapshots
Express the hook overhead as a fraction of runtime
Request detailed snapshots only when cheap metrics change

label: Injecting behavior safely
subgoals: Restrict injection to defined points between phases
Classify each injected change by its tier
Re-check engine invariants after every injection
